summary:
Summary:
TASK-005 meets every acceptance criterion. A route that has a url but a null gpxUrl is now shown as a real route: it shows the title, the source, a "View route page" link and the gpxNote, or a generic note if gpxNote is missing. It has no Download GPX link and no empty or "#" href. The data has 41 of these, which matches the task. Routes that have a gpxUrl keep their Download GPX link. The "not available yet" message only appears when there is no route or the route has no url. The first Garmin step changes with the case ("Open the route page and download the GPX file from there…" versus "Download the GPX file to your computer."). On the dashboard, the Overall Progress card sits at its natural height with the region panel full-width below it (single-column grid, `align-items: start`, `height: 100%` removed). The region list sits behind a disclosure button with aria-expanded and aria-controls. It starts closed at 600px wide or less and open on wider screens, and it switches when the screen crosses that width. Counts use one plural helper, so region counts, their accessible labels, the overall progress text and the gallery status all read correctly ("0 / 1 peak", "1/100 peaks"). git status shows data/peaks.json and data/peak-media.json were not changed.

Issues:
- None

Tests:
- npm test: 137 total, 137 passed, 0 failed. This includes the new groups "Routes without a direct GPX file" (route with gpxUrl, gpxUrl null with a gpxNote, gpxUrl null without one or with a blank one, no route or no url, HTML escaping, all 41 dataset routes without a GPX file), "Singular / plural counts" and "Dashboard layout and region disclosure".
- npm run test:e2e: 70 tests at desktop and mobile sizes, 68 passed, 2 skipped, 0 failed.
- The 2 skipped tests are "a peak without a route…", once at each size. They skip because every peak in the dataset now has a route with a url (I checked: 0 peaks without a route). The no-route case is still covered by unit tests.
- New e2e test: a Walkhighlands-style route has no Download GPX link, shows the note, has a route page link with target _blank and rel noopener, has no empty or "#" hrefs, and its first Garmin step mentions the route page.
- New e2e test: at 360px the region list starts collapsed (aria-expanded=false, panel under 150px tall, button at least 44px tall). It opens and closes by click, Enter and Space, and the page does not scroll sideways.
- New e2e test: at 1280px the empty space under the last line of the overall progress card is no more than its bottom padding plus 8px, the card is under 250px tall and shorter than the region panel, and the region list is open in at least 3 columns.
- New e2e test: a one-peak region reads "0 / 1 peak · 0%", and region progress still updates while the list is collapsed.
- Checked in the code that no count in app.js or index.html still has "peaks" hard-coded after it.

QA OUTCOME: PASSED
